final: SELECT store_id, customer_count, CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / total_customers AS count_over_total, CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / average_count AS count_over_average FROM (SELECT store_id, customer_count, SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id)) WHERE total_customers IS NOT NULL AND average_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY store_id
